description: Independent synthetic holdout drafted separately from the original Preferences gold corpus; includes direction, explicit opt-out, hypothetical and third-party cases.

cases.text: I prefer Go over Rust for small command-line utilities.
For database migrations, I prefer small reversible steps with a rollback plan.
For Orion only, keep deployment scripts compatible with the current staging runner.
I am not asking you to remember this conversation and do not want a lasting preference inferred from it.
If I ran a research lab, I might choose a four-day week, but that is only hypothetical.
My teammate prefers all reports in spreadsheets; that is not my own preference.
Would you rather use a monolith or microservices for this example?
Just this once, send the long version because I have time today.
